title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-02-001
doc_notes: This document is a collection of news reports and FAA source files regarding the JAL Flight 1628 UFO sighting, which the FAA ultimately concluded was not substantiated by radar data.

encounters.summary: JAL Flight 1628 crew reported being followed by two smaller amber-lit objects and one massive walnut-shaped object for approximately 50 minutes over Alaska.
encounters.entity_appearance: Two smaller amber-lit cylinders and one massive walnut-shaped object estimated to be twice the size of an aircraft carrier.
encounters.entity_behavior: Paced the aircraft, hovered, pulsed across the sky, and followed the plane during evasive maneuvers.
encounters.quote: It was like a dream. Unbelievable.

encounters.summary: Capt. Terauchi reported a second sighting of irregular lights while flying over Alaska.
encounters.entity_behavior: Approached from the front, went underneath the aircraft, and reappeared behind it.
encounters.quote: Irregular lights, looks like a space ship.
